name: Jeffrey C. McNeely

items.text: In May 2023, during a House debate, McNeely asked Rep. Abe Jones, who is Black, whether he could have gotten into Harvard if he were not "an athlete or a minority." McNeely apologized, calling it a "misstep," and Jones accepted. McNeely then resigned as deputy whip after GOP leaders sought it. He kept his seat.
items.why: The remark is on record and led to a loss of a leadership post, but it involves no abuse of office, self-dealing or false statements about his record, so it doesn't clearly bear on any criterion.

for_review: The search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up nothing about McNeely. I did not open McNeely's own apology statement; the Iredell Free News article linked to it. The Spectrum News report was seen only as a search snippet and not opened. No other items were added: I ran no searches on his finances, business dealings, or other conduct.
